gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-suse-mono: SUSE Mono reads like a plain sans with generous breathing room, each letter given extra space on both sides and curves left wide open. Bruno Ace SC stretches above it, strung out and unthinned.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-tajawal: Strokes that never thin or swell give Bruno Ace SC its look, every letter drawn like one length of tubing. Tajawal follows in a plain sans, its c a broad open hook.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-tasa-explorer: Sleek and spaced out. Bruno Ace SC cuts its letters like constant-width ribbon, while TASA Explorer lets its curves finish like brush strokes lifted early. One shouts, one murmurs.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-tasa-orbiter: Bruno Ace SC looks drawn with a technical pen, every line held to the same steady width and every letter open. TASA Orbiter keeps its small counters unclogged, so paragraphs of text stay easy to move through.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-teachers: Bruno Ace SC spreads its open, unthinned letters out like beads on a long thread. Teachers answers with the sharpest quality of the pair: thin, steel-rod lines in a modern sans-serif whose ink strokes taper away before touching.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-tenor-sans: Tenor Sans keeps its c tips well apart and lets its curved strokes lighten mildly toward the ends. And Bruno Ace SC does the opposite, running neon-tube strokes of constant width in wide, open letters.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-tirra: Tirra builds its round forms like open parentheses, a modern plain sans that never crowds itself. And Bruno Ace SC supplies the cable-like strokes, each one holding a single thickness from end to end.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-titillium-web: Wide, bright and machined. Bruno Ace SC draws every stroke at one thickness, and Titillium Web, a plain sans, sets its stroke ends far apart. Yet the two share an openness that makes them fit.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-tomorrow: Distinctive is the first word for Bruno Ace SC, whose monoline strokes run from start to finish without a single taper. Tomorrow's bowls open like a cupped palm, so text keeps moving smoothly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-trispace: Bruno Ace SC strings its open, untapered letters along the line like beads, with no thinning where strokes meet or end. Trispace, a plain sans, simply sets sparse, widely spaced letters and curves opening outward.
